text: EU Russia assets, Ukraine reparations, Brussels reactions, frozen assets, EU Council, geopolitics, wMetroTV, People in Brussels voiced growing concerns over the European Union’s proposal to use frozen Russian assets to guarantee a $140 billion reparations loan for Ukraine, ahead of an expected EU Council discussion. Several residents warned that the move could carry serious legal, financial and security risks. Critics argued that seizing even state-owned Russian assets could violate international law and damage Europe’s credibility as a financial hub. Others warned that the plan could trigger capital flight from Europe and provoke retaliation from Russia, escalating tensions further. Some also questioned whether the funds would truly reach Ukraine, claiming much of the money would circulate within Western financial and defence systems instead.The proposal remains under discussion among EU leaders. #EU #RussiaAssets #UkraineLoan #Brussels #EuropeanUnion #Geopolitics #WorldNews
